# ArchiveTune v16.1.0

ArchiveTune **16.1.0** is a minor release focused on improving YouTube Music playback reliability, expanding the modules system, strengthening media-session integration, and refining lyrics controls and application settings.

This update introduces **hardware-backed module attestation**, expanded module capabilities for lyrics, track metadata, and Canvas, **official audio playback for music videos**, synchronized YouTube Music lyrics, and improved network fallback handling. It also addresses media notification issues, improves YouTube deep-link compatibility, and brings several interface refinements.

---

## ✨ Highlights

### ⚡ YouTube Music Playback & Stream Reliability

YouTube Music playback receives additional improvements to stream resolution, account compatibility, and network handling.

- Added **official audio stream prioritization** when playing music videos, with video playback as a fallback when the official audio stream is unavailable.
- Improved handling of `NO_FORMAT` responses across authenticated and anonymous YouTube streaming clients.
- Extended stream resolution error handling to recognize rejected-login conditions associated with missing playable formats.
- Added **IPv4-preferred DNS resolution** and playback address-family fallback support.
- Refined network connection handling with conditional DNS configuration and connection-aware fallback behavior.
- Updated YouTube account parsing to recognize renamed `accountItem` entries and `datasyncIdToken` values.

**Contributor:** @rukamori @mikooochi 

---

### 🧩 Expanded Modules System & Hardware Attestation

The modules system now supports more content integrations and gives external providers greater control over playback behavior.

- Added **opt-in hardware-backed application attestation** for modules.
- Expanded module content capabilities to support:
  - **Lyrics** providers.
  - **Track metadata** providers.
  - **Canvas** integrations.
- Extended module playback resolution to provide the **full song context**, allowing modules to use more complete track information.
- Added support for modules to handle their **own playback errors** through module-specific recovery behavior.
- Improved playback error attribution to distinguish between module-provided audio and YouTube Music sources.
- Refined module audio selection and resolution logic.

These changes expand the scope of module integrations beyond audio-stream resolution.

**Contributor:** @rukamori @mikooochi 

---

### 🎤 Lyrics, Synchronization & Sharing

Lyrics functionality receives additional source support, more flexible controls, and a refreshed sharing experience.

- Added **synchronized YouTube Music lyrics** through the `ANDROID_MUSIC` Innertube client.
- Replaced the previous auto-hide lyrics controls switch with a **three-option button group**:
  - **Hide** — Keep lyrics controls hidden.
  - **Auto** — Automatically manage control visibility.
  - **Show** — Keep lyrics controls visible.
- Replaced hardcoded legacy preference migration with automatic migration handling.
- Refreshed the **Lyrics Share dialog** with updated presentation and visual styling.
- Replaced device blur-level handling with **Haze-based blur effects** in the lyrics sharing interface.
- Refactored the lyrics style selection indicator into a reusable component.
- Removed the built-in **Musixmatch lyrics provider**.

**Contributor:** @rukamori @mikooochi @adam-adrian 

---

### 🎨 Interface, Playback Errors & Settings

Several interfaces receive targeted refinements for improved clarity and consistency.

- Redesigned the **Playback Error dialog** with clearer source attribution for YouTube Music and module playback failures.
- Removed the playback error dialog's previous toggle control.
- Refreshed **Experimental Settings** with an updated layout and presentation.

ArchiveTune

Redefining the YouTube Music Experience on Android.
It’s high-performance, privacy-focused, and packed with features for people who really care about their experience.

Official Website • Features • Privacy • Download • Screenshots • Support

They are **not verified or supported by the ArchiveTune maintainers** and should **not be mistaken for official releases**. Their contents and safety cannot be guaranteed. > > **Get the official ArchiveTune only from trusted sources:** [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/rukamori/ArchiveTune/releases/latest), [Obtainium (via the official GitHub repository)](https://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/redirect?r=obtainium://add/https://github.com/rukamori/ArchiveTune/), or Early-access builds are provided through the [official ArchiveTune Discord](https://discord.gg/archivetune). > > If you encounter a Google Play listing impersonating ArchiveTune, **report it to Google Play** and [notify the maintainers](https://github.com/rukamori/ArchiveTune/issues/new/choose). --- > [!WARNING] **Forks are not supported in any way.** We do not provide support, maintenance, troubleshooting, or assistance for any forked version of this project. If you choose to use a fork, you do so at your own risk. **ArchiveTune** isn’t just another generic YouTube Music wrapper. It’s a fully custom-built player made with kotlin and jetpack compose, because we think your music should stay private, look clean, and work exactly the way you expect. --- > [!IMPORTANT] > **Geographic Availability:** If YouTube Music is not supported in your region, a VPN or proxy set to a supported region is required for initial data fetching. --- ## 📸 Showcase
--- ## ✨ Features

Playback

  • Multiple account support with quick switching
  • Ad-free playback with background listening
  • Sponsor blocks support
  • Your playlists, liked songs, and subscriptions appear after sign-in
  • Support local file and local song playback
  • Customizable player and notification interface
  • Highly support android auto
  • Fast startup and lightweight performance
  • Built for a private, uninterrupted listening experience

Audio

  • EBU R128 loudness normalization
  • Bit perfect and DAC support
  • Tempo, pitch, and playback speed controls
  • Crossfade between tracks
  • Customizable Equalizer, Equalizer system and spatial audio integration
  • Hi-res audio playback modules.

Lyrics & Discovery

  • Live synced lyrics
  • Apple music lyrics feels
  • Lyrics translation, AI Lyrics translation and romanization
  • Music recognition for songs around you
  • Listening statistics whenever you want them

Sync & Social

  • Import playlist from spotify
  • Online and offline backup and restore support
  • YouTube Music account integration
  • Last.fm, libre.fm and custom scrobbling
  • ListenBrainz history sync
  • Customizable discord rich presence support

Interface

  • Built with material 3 expressive
  • Multi customizable interface
  • Album-art powered dynamic colors
  • Up to 11 different player styles
  • Up to 8 different player background styles
  • Responsive layouts for different screen sizes
  • Animated Artwork while playing
  • Clean browsing, player, artist, album, and lyrics views

Customization

  • Deep playback and interface settings
  • Dynamic color theming options
  • Gesture customization
  • Animation and layout tuning
  • Flexible controls to shape the app around your workflow
--- ## Module development ArchiveTune supports `.arch` provider packages installed from a file, a direct URL, or a catalog.
